failures: tests/test_field_data.py::test_no_group_in_two_field_splits calls check('field'), which requires every manifest image to exist on disk (src/sprout/data/check_splits.py line 16). Without datasets/raw the plain `pytest -q` fails, which breaks the no-raw-data rule in docs/TESTING.md and CLAUDE.md. Reproduce: run the test with datasets/raw absent, or use own_T1.2_a.py. Fix by using only the manifest-level checks in the test, or by skipping the on-disk part when raw is absent.

Near-duplicates survive across field splits. The same alamy tomato early blight photo is in field_dev labelled Potato___Early_blight (group g052319) and in field_train labelled Tomato___Early_blight (g052914); plantseg corn_northern_leaf_blight_3.jpg (train, g054249) and corn_northern_leaf_blight_56.jpg (dev, g054267) are the same scene cropped differently. In all, 3 pairs lie within 2 dHash bits across splits. The task asks to deduplicate against each other, and test_no_group_in_two_field_splits only checks the group column, so it cannot see this. Fix by grouping with a looser perceptual threshold and by dropping the conflicting-label duplicate.

datasets/class_map.csv: all 27 shared plantdoc rows have the reason 'no matching lab class', which contradicts status 'shared' (default reason set in make_class_map in src/sprout/data/field.py). The recorded reasons are wrong.
notes: Test strength: removing the sha1 dedupe, the unmapped-class filter (lab_class != ''), or the complete-split filter in assemble_field leaves all 8 tests passing, so those branches have no effective test. The unmapped test passes because unmapped rows get an empty label rather than the source label; the assertion 'weird' not in labels cannot catch them. The lab near-duplicate check used a 20k random sample of lab, not the full set. PlantSeg contains many fruit images; crop is right but they differ from leaf images. PlantDoc upstream label noise exists (the potato/tomato duplicate), which suggests the H2 label review matters. Nothing under datasets/raw or legacy was changed. Own test files are in orchestration/evidence/tmp-T1.2/.
